page.layout: One page: a title page with centred lines of large and small capitals. Below the title block, a printer's imprint in the lower part of the page. A library stamp (BSB München) at the foot is omitted. Heavy show-through from the reverse side runs through the whole page, so most lines are only partly legible.
page.notes: Title page, type "title". Show-through from the reverse side is very strong and mirrored; I have not transcribed it. Only the largest capitals are reasonably clear. The top line may read "ORATIO", but that is uncertain. The city name at the foot may be ROSTOCHII, and the date may be in the MDC range, but neither is certain. A few lines of the title block cannot be read at all and are marked illegible. A higher-resolution scan or a crop of the title block would allow a much more accurate transcription. The BSB München stamp is not transcribed.
